status: Engineering reference contract; not an Integral ratified specification
purpose: Make the public Integral assurance vocabulary executable without allowing implicit epistemic, authority, provenance, temporal, or scope promotion.
source_status_rule: Integral public concept != Mycelix implementation contract != ratified Integral specification != conformance evidence
global_invariants: coordination_envelope dissolves when declared exit criteria are satisfied
origin_rule: Recognition may grant local decision-use under explicit policy while preserving foreign origin and source lineage.
temporal_rule: Historical evidence remains queryable after expiry or supersession but cannot satisfy an active current-validity predicate unless an explicit policy says otherwise.
recommendation_rule: FRS-derived recommendations are non-executive analytical outputs; they require an explicit receiving-system decision and authorization path before effect.
viability_rule: Viability threshold transitions require admissible current evidence bound to the relevant node, scope, and validity window.
coordination_rule: A Coordination Envelope is bounded by affected nodes, shared constraints, decision scope, authority reference, expiry/exit criteria, and dissolution lineage.
formal_closure_policy: No transition is formally closed merely by a passing example, scalar confidence score, or abstract model. Closure requires a reproducible formal artifact, executable witness, production refinement witness, exact source commit, and reproducible build identity.
claim_ceiling: This contract establishes semantic transition boundaries only; it does not establish physical safety, productivity, economic fairness, ecological performance, cryptographic security, or Integral ratification.
